# f5xc_tgw_info (Resource)

AWS TGW site view defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage a volterra site in AWS VPC.<br>It can be used to automatically site creation in the AWS TGW.<br><br>View will create following child objects.<br><br>* Site

To get more information about f5xc_tgw_info, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-aws-tgw-site)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Tgw Info - Basic

resource "f5xc_aws_tgw_site" "site" {
  name      = "example-aws-tgw-info"
  namespace = "system"

  aws_parameters = {
    aws_region = "us-west-2"
    az_nodes = [{
      aws_az_name = "us-west-2a"
      choice = {
        reserved_inside_subnet = true
      }
      outside_subnet = {
        choice = {
          subnet_param = {
            ipv4 = "10.10.1.0/24"
          }
        }
      }
    }]
    deployment_choice = {
      aws_cred = {
        name      = "volterra-dev-test"
        namespace = "system"
      }
    }
    instance_type = "t3.xlarge"
    internet_vip_choice = {
      disable_internet_vip = true
    }
    security_group_choice = {
      f5xc_security_group = true
    }
    service_vpc_choice = {
      new_vpc = {
        name_choice = {
          autogenerate = true
        }
        primary_ipv4 = "10.10.0.0/16"
      }
    }
    ssh_key = "ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQD3b9ZcE4fVYI7xQ1jQk7n4k3bM1XlI3oVf9v2yW1sYvWm2n3z4k5w6x7y8z9acc"
    tgw_choice = {
      new_tgw = {
        asn_choice = {
          system_generated = true
        }
      }
    }
    tgw_cidr_choice = {
      reserved_tgw_cidr = true
    }
    worker_nodes_choice = {
      no_worker_nodes = true
    }
  }

  blocked_services_choice = {
    block_all_services = true
  }

  direct_connect_choice = {
    direct_connect_disabled = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = all
  }
}


resource "f5xc_tgw_info" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_aws_tgw_site.site.name
  namespace = "system"

  tgw_info = {
    tgw_id      = "tgw-1234abcd"
    vpc_id      = "vpc-1234abcd"
    private_ips = ["10.10.10.10"]
    public_ips  = ["34.10.10.10"]
    subnet_ids = [
      {
        az_name           = "us-east-1a"
        inside_subnet_id  = "subnet-1234abcd"
        outside_subnet_id = "subnet-2234abcd"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''

### Optional

- `direct_connect_info` (Attributes) Direct Connect information Direct Connect information obtained after creating the site and TGW (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--direct_connect_info))
- `tgw_info` (Attributes) AWS TGW Info Config AWS TGW Info Config (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tgw_info))
